desktop.notesZh:
批次十九（会话工作流图页重排 + 测试流图品牌化 + 验证门「跑过的测试必须通过」+ 确认门明细提亮）
① 会话·工作流图：「变更分类 / 阶段产物 / 会话统计」三卡从右侧栏搬到固定左侧栏（宽度固定 300px，不随窗口变），右侧栏只保留阶段相关内容，并在最顶部新增醒目的阶段名称抬头（大字 + 提示语，「现在在哪个阶段」一眼可见）。
② 变更总览不再以模态框出现在会话里——台账统一搬到「工作流」页面的「变更总览」页签，页面整体重做为卡片式台账（项目路径 + 四枚汇总磁贴 + 变更卡片网格，醒目和谐）；点击任一变更项再弹出详情框，内含该变更的阶段流程、阶段产物、耗时与 Tokens、开始时间以及完整历史记录（每条事件带时间戳与中文标签）。
③ 顶部信息框新增「开始时间」（格式 2026-10-23 12:34:56）；所有按钮右对齐，从左到右依次为「配置、刷新、变更总览」。
④ 会话·测试流图：顶部左侧标签改为与工作流图一致的 BAF 徽标，两页徽标文字均为白色；「全部运行」按钮的文字与 logo 同样改为白色（白字改用深金品牌底色，保证对比度）。
⑤ 报告时间统一格式化为 2026-10-23 12:34:56（本地时区），涵盖测试流图页的报告时间与执行结果行、右栏时间指标，以及独立变更看板的「生成时间」；无法解析的时间原样显示，不编造日期。
⑥ 验证阶段规则收紧：工作流触发的测试流会生成报告（.baf/reports/ut-coverage.json 与 static-analysis.json），该报告已纳入验证阶段的必需产物与客户产物栏；确认门改为「跑过的测试必须通过」——只要某项检查真正执行过且未通过，即使它不是必需项也会阻断归档；真正没跑过的检查（跳过 / 工具不可用 / 已取消）仍然只作标注不阻断。验证报告的措辞同步改正，不再出现「不阻断」的误导表述。
⑦ 工作流·确认门页：「需求输入」节点重做为金色品牌卡（渐变底、描边、图标、留白），门禁明细由灰色分层改为统一金色体系，确认门标题只写一次、嵌套层级拍平（「澄清已完成 · 请确认进入设计」不再重复出现）。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch nineteen (session workflow page relayout + test-flow branding + the verify gate’s “a test that ran must pass” rule + brighter gate details)
(1) Session · workflow graph: the 变更分类 / 阶段产物 / 会话统计 cards moved off the right rail into a FIXED left column (a constant 300 px, independent of the window width); the right rail keeps only the stage-scoped content and gained a prominent stage header at its top (the stage name in large type plus a hint line) so “which stage am I in” reads at a glance.
(2) The change overview no longer opens as a modal inside the session — the ledger moved to the workflow page’s 变更总览 tab, which was rebuilt as a card ledger (project path + four summary tiles + a change-card grid, vivid and harmonious); clicking any change opens a detail modal with that change’s stage flow, stage artifacts, duration and tokens, start time, and the complete event history (every event stamped and labelled in Chinese).
(3) The top info box gained a 开始时间 (formatted 2026-10-23 12:34:56); every button is now right-aligned, ordered 配置 → 刷新 → 变更总览.
(4) Session · test-flow graph: the top-left label became the same BAF brand mark the workflow graph shows, and both marks read white; the 全部运行 button’s label and logo are white too (white text now sits on a darker gold brand fill so the contrast holds).
(5) Report timestamps are now formatted 2026-10-23 12:34:56 (local time) — the test-flow page’s report time and result lines, the rail’s timestamp metrics, and the standalone board’s 生成时间 all read alike; an unparsable timestamp is shown verbatim rather than fabricated.
(6) The verify stage is stricter: the test flow a workflow triggers produces reports (.baf/reports/ut-coverage.json and static-analysis.json), and those reports are now verify-stage artifacts and customer-visible artifact rows; the confirm gate now enforces “a test that ran must pass” — any check that actually ran and did not pass blocks the archive even when it is not required, while a check that genuinely never ran (skipped / tool unavailable / cancelled) still only annotates. The verify report’s wording was corrected so it no longer claims a blocking failure is “non-blocking”.
(7) Workflow · confirm-gate page: the 需求输入 node was rebuilt as a gold brand card (gradient fill, outline, icon, breathing room), the gate detail moved from grey tiers to one gold system, and the confirm-gate title is now written exactly once with the nesting flattened (“clarify done · please confirm entering design” no longer appears twice).
